answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity stakes a timber bond of 50 units and makes cipher-signed trades. Over 20 epochs, full rewards need 30 counterparties, no cluster above 20% of volume. A sybil ring trades with itself, so its diversity stays near 3; its bond is slashed, rewards withheld. Forging 100 identities costs about 11,000 units, while one honest agent pays one 50-unit bond and keeps full rewards at the zenith of each epoch.
